Biography

The Making of
a Legend

Born on August 29, 1958, in Gary, Indiana, Michael Joseph Jackson would grow to become the most celebrated entertainer the world has ever seen. From humble beginnings in a small house with eight siblings, he was destined for something extraordinary.

His childhood was consumed by music — performing with his brothers in The Jackson 5 from the age of five, he possessed an innate ability to transform raw emotion into transcendent performance. His voice, his movement, his presence — all spoke in a language that transcended culture and geography.

As a solo artist, Jackson shattered every record and redefined every boundary. His 1982 album Thriller remains the best-selling album of all time. His music videos were cinematic masterpieces. His philanthropy touched millions. His influence on every genre — pop, R&B, funk, soul — is immeasurable and eternal.

Timeline
1958

Born in Gary, Indiana

Michael Joseph Jackson enters the world, the eighth of ten children.

1964

The Jackson 5

Joins brothers in the family group, showcasing impossible talent at age six.

1971

Solo debut

"Got to Be There" marks the beginning of his parallel solo career.

1982

Thriller released

The greatest selling album of all time reshapes pop culture forever.

1983

The Moonwalk

Debuts the moonwalk on Motown 25, sending the world into collective awe.

2009

A King transcends

Michael Jackson passes on June 25, leaving behind an eternal legacy.
